result.quote: and Gaal fled before him. And many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate.
result.reason: Gaal’s flight is supported, but the window says that many Shechemites were wounded, not that they died. Also, “What happens” is broad enough to include Abimelech pursuing Gaal. The question should specify which outcomes are requested, and the key should say that many Shechemites fell wounded.
